description: Turn pasted text (a recipe, protocol, run sheet or training plan) into a validated multi-track program on the server, in four model turns, with a table of the source span each step came from. Use when the user pastes the steps and no URL importer fits. Needs the user's Rhylthyme account. Capped per day; you can instead author the program yourself and call validate_program.

deadline.description: When everything must be finished, if the user said: '18:00', 'dinner at six', an ISO datetime.

environmentType.description: kitchen, lab, events, gym or generic.

hints.description: Equipment and people limits in the user's words, e.g. 'one oven, two burners, one cook'.

text.description: The source text, all of it, as the user wrote or pasted it.

token.description: Access token from the login tool. Omit when the account is connected.

name: import_text
title: Import pasted text
